title: FS BLDG T112 8 NIPR DROP INSTALLATION
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE ARMY > AMC > ACC > ACC-OO > 413TH CSB > 0413 AQ HQ     RCO-HI
description:
Contractor shall provide personnel, management, tools, equipment, parts and materials, transportation and other items and services necessary to install eight (8) SIPR connections (4 user drop locations) for Bldg. T112 at Ft. Shafter, Hawaii. Contractor shall label all drops and equipment according to the NEC Standardized Labeling Program. Contractor shall abide by all TIA/EIA standards for Telecommunication installation. 

 Site Visit 

 19 Nov 2026 @ 1330, Fort Shafter Bldg T112 

 Site visit POC: Kyle Mishima  POC Kyle Mishima (808) 787-0491 

  Site Visit (Apr 1984)  
Offerors or quoters are urged and expected to inspect the site where services are to be performed and to satisfy themselves regarding all general and local conditions that may affect the cost of contract performance, to the extent that the information is reasonably obtainable.  In no event shall failure to inspect the site constitute grounds for a claim after contract award.
